notes.title: Update 1.0.4.0 available
notes.content:
Hi Folks, 

today the new update 1.0.4.0 is available. Some fixes are made, again. 

-fixed Masterbot to fight if you cancel the cutscene
-fixed a missing fyling pod in the cutscene of Level 8
-fixed a checktpoint in Level 10 where you sometimes fly through the world if you load the game
-fixed the loading of the graphics Setup (now they should properly load)
-fixed Masterbots health at the last fight
-fixed a achievement, due a Problem you where not be able to get this achievement. Now it should work
-added a preview of ball attacks (this free update is still work in Progress)
-added the possibility to restart each Level if you stuck or if you want to restart it. The button for this is set up under New Game in the difficulty Screen


Greetings
Beregron
Soundstage13

notes.title: New Release this week!
notes.content:
Hi lovely players!

During this week, i'll upload a new Release. 
Some changes this time. 


- Changed to Unreal Engine 4.15
- Changed now the executable to 64bit for better performance
- Steam Achievements are now fully working 
- Improved the Main Menu (a little bit)
- Changed the behavior from Doors with riddle. Now you should be able to pass the door after loading a game. 
- Deactivated the SteamVR plugin. So SteamVR is no longer starting automatic if you start the game


I hope this is working for all. 

Greetings
Beregron
Soundstage13

notes.title: Again! Next Release is coming!
notes.content:
Hi again, 

the next Release is coming this week on Friday. 


With this Release i changed something: 

- Some Enemies are stronger or have a larger detection radius
- Loading screen should now drawn correctly
- Fixed some bugs with the collect all discs achievement (hope this work for all)
- Fixed a starting bug on the starting point in level 3 (at our machines there   where no problems anymore)
- Possibility to change your keyboard and controller settings through the options menu
- For those who did not know: Now you can skip the sequences with any button (sometimes there are a loading bug)
- Changed the behavior of the weapon "Magic Bullet" This weapon have now 350 damage and will be saved to your player after changing the level
- Added more batterys for healing your player. On the easiest level the game is now "EASY"! YEAH!
- Added two post process functions in the options menu: Now you can play the game in Black and White or in a blurred way like drunken

Let me know if there are more problems. 

Note: I have to change back to 4.14.3 due problems with the achievements. The game uses 32bit again.

Greetings
Beregron
Soundstage13

notes.title: Where Is My Brain!? Patch 1.0.2.3 is coming this day
notes.content:
Hi Folks!

This day the next Patch for Where Is My Brain!? get online. This Patch fixes some Bugs in the first level. With this Patch the Y-Button on the XBox Controller or the Key 9 on the keyboard can be used to skip cutscenes. 

The checkpoints are improved as well and and some enemies are twieked. 

Have Fun with it...


Greetings
Sascha
Soundstage13
